name: DETOUR_FOR_HEAVY_VEHICLES_YELLOW_POINTED
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet T1-SA114 (L or R): 2100 x 600 board pointed at the left end — point 225 long (apex at mid-height), R100 at the two right corners; outside the outline is transparent. Black border measured 28 wide (not stated), yellow ground. Chevron per CHEVRON DETAILS: 175 + 215 wide, 460 high (230 + 230), its right extreme 550 from the apex, 70 from top and bottom. DETOUR 586 + 90 + FOR 283, 120 D, baseline 255 (329 right margin); HEAVY 505 + 80 + VEHICLES 728, 120 D, baseline 465 (210 pitch, 135 below; 90 after the chevron, 147 right margin — the sheet's 80 and 90 labels sit under the wrong gaps; the drawing and the 2100 total fix the order). The drawing sets the top line about 14 to the right of its own chain (DETOUR at 826, right margin 315): the stated chain is used. The sheet draws the left-pointing board; (R) mirrors the board and chevron, with the legend lines kept reading left to right at the mirrored margins.
